title: Cyrus and the Alibi
author: K. M. Okonkwo
blurb: Coral Eastwick, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
